research: [spread] Line opened Kansas State -2.5 and had not moved by game day even though about 66% of spread tickets were on Houston (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Money matching the public number without a move is a mild sign for Kansas State; Covers' consensus showed a near 50/50 split, so the read is weak.
[spread] Houston failed to cover in its last two games, as -17.5 at Georgia Southern and -10.5 vs UCF (SI, Oct 9 2026). Its game-to-game margins have run short of the market. Helps Kansas State.
[spread] Both teams failed to cover their last two. Kansas State lost outright as a 6.5-point road favorite at Cincinnati, 31-26 (SI Oct 9; Predictem Oct 8 2026). Neutral.
Kansas State is off a bye (two weeks since Cincinnati) and at home. Houston comes off a 27-17 comeback over UCF after trailing 17-0 in the 3rd quarter (Predictem, Oct 8 2026). Helps Kansas State.

[angle] Houston's leading tackler, LB Jaden Yates (Ole Miss transfer, 29 tackles), is out with a leg injury from the UCF game (Roundtable, Oct 8 2026). That matters against a run-first Kansas State QB averaging 9.7 yards per carry (Sportschatplace preview). Helps Kansas State.
[angle] Kansas State coach Collin Klein was Conner Weigman's offensive coordinator at Texas A&M in 2024 (SI, Oct 9 2026). Klein knows the QB's tendencies well. Slightly helps Kansas State.

[angle] Kansas State lost TE Will Anciaux for the season at Cincinnati. Only one QB was available in that game; backups Barnett, Duff and Knuth were listed day to day (Roundtable, Oct 6 2026). If Avery Johnson gets hurt, there's little behind him. Helps Houston.

Kansas State allowed 270 rushing yards to Cincinnati, and Avery Johnson had to throw 50 times (Predictem, Oct 8 2026). Weigman ran 13 times for 50 yards and 3 TDs vs UCF, and his dual threat fits that weakness. Helps Houston.

Season numbers are almost even: Houston 41.0 ppg, 19.8 allowed, 483 ypg; Kansas State 40.5 ppg, 15.2 allowed, 480 ypg (Sportschatplace preview, Oct 2026). Kansas State's defense is a little better per game. Slight edge to Kansas State.
Weigman: 67.4%, 1,186 yards, 11 TD, 1 INT. Houston's only loss was 28-26 at Texas Tech, and it has scored 26+ in all five games (SI, Oct 9 2026). Helps Houston keep it within the number.

Trend notes: Kansas State has covered four straight as a home favorite against Texas teams but failed to cover in 4 of its last 5 conference games. Houston has covered six straight conference road games (Sportschatplace preview). These conflict, so neutral.
Pundits split: Predictem and Sports Gambling Podcast took Houston +2.5; The RX took Kansas State -2.5 (search summaries, Oct 8-10 2026). Neutral.
games.reasoning: Two near-identical offenses with Kansas State a bit better on defense, rested and at home, against a Houston defense missing its leading tackler: I make it Kansas State by about 3. That is right on the 2.5 line, so I pass. The best angle is Klein having coached Weigman at A&M, set against Kansas State's thin QB depth. A clear injury to Johnson or a line move off 2.5 would have decided it.

research: Oregon starting QB Dante Moore (926 yards, 9 TD, 0 INT) is out with a concussion from the USC game on Sept 26. Nebraska transfer Dylan Raiola makes his first Oregon start; he went 19/25, 289 yards, 2 TD in relief at USC (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026; NBC Sports, Oct 8 2026). Helps UCLA.

[spread] Line movement: Oregon opened -11.5 and dropped to -10.5 at some books (TheSpread, Oct 10). NBC had -12.5 on Thursday. VegasInsider lists an open of -11 and consensus near -10. The market drifted toward UCLA, and 11.5 is at the top of the range. Helps UCLA.
[spread] UCLA is 4-0 ATS and 4-0 to the over; Oregon is 2-2 ATS (NBC Sports, Oct 8 2026). Helps UCLA.
[spread] Splits: 65% of spread tickets on UCLA (TheSpread, Oct 10). The public is with UCLA, which tempers the move somewhat. Neutral to slightly against UCLA.

[angle] Matchup: UCLA runs for 281.5 ypg (4th in FBS) at 6.95 yards per carry (1st), led by Wayne Knight (445 yards, 9 TD) (TheSpread, Oct 10). Oregon ranks 101st against the rush and 129th in early-down EPA allowed (VegasInsider pre-game pick). Helps UCLA, which can shorten the game and keep the margin down.
Net adjusted EPA/play: UCLA 14th, Oregon 18th (VegasInsider). On efficiency the two teams are about even, which argues against a two-score number. Helps UCLA.
Oregon lost 39-31 at Oklahoma State and allows 23.3 ppg; UCLA allows 18.8 ppg and has a +8 turnover margin (TheSpread Oct 10; NBC Oct 8). Helps UCLA.
Oregon is 28-2 at home under Dan Lanning, has won 5 straight in the series and 8 straight in Eugene, and leads the nation in third-down defense (21.2%) (TheSpread, Oct 10). Helps Oregon.
UCLA's passing is limited: Nico Iamaleava throws for about 205 ypg (96th), and the Bruins have not been an underdog all season (TheSpread, Oct 10). If Oregon forces UCLA to throw, that helps Oregon.

[angle] Both teams come off a bye. UCLA is 4-0 in Bob Chesney's first year after going 3-9 last season, and its last win at Autzen was in 2004 (Daily Bruin preview, Oct 9 2026). The program is ascending, but this is its first ranked road test. Mixed.
Oregon scores 47.5 ppg (4th), boosted by an 84-0 win over Portland State; its 145 passes have produced no interceptions (TheSpread, Oct 10). Helps Oregon if Raiola keeps that clean.
games.reasoning: With Moore out, a backup QB making his first Oregon start, a weak Oregon run defense facing the nation's most efficient rushing team, and the market moving down from 11.5-12.5, I had UCLA covering +11.5 (Oregon by about 6.5) before the contamination below. The best angle is the run-game mismatch: it shortens the game, which protects a double-digit dog. A confirmed return by Moore or a move up through 12 would have changed it.
games.contaminationNote: After I had already formed the UCLA lean (from the TheSpread, NBC Sports and VegasInsider previews), a search for UCLA pre-game news returned an AI summary and headlines (ABC7, Daily Bruin) saying UCLA beat Oregon 17-15 and Iamaleava was hurt in the game. I did not change the pick or confidence after seeing it. Separately, the VegasInsider preview page I read was marked 'Updated on 11/22/26', but the text I got back showed no result.

research: [spread] Ole Miss is 1-3 ATS this season. It came off a Week 5 bye after allowing 52 points in a 52-28 loss to Florida (SI, Oct 7 2026; SportsBettingDime, Oct 10 2026). Helps Vanderbilt.

[spread] The Kalshi spread market was about even: Ole Miss -9.5 at 52 cents, Vanderbilt +9.5 at 49 cents (SportsBettingDime, Oct 10 2026). DraftKings had -10 earlier in the week (SI, Oct 7), so there was a slight move toward Vanderbilt. Neutral.

[spread] Ole Miss averages 35.5 ppg and 440 ypg; Vanderbilt 25.4 ppg and 349 ypg. Ole Miss has a -4 turnover margin, Vanderbilt 0 (SportsBettingDime, Oct 10). The gap is about 10 points a game, the size of the spread. Neutral.
Ole Miss's defense ranks 106th in adjusted EPA/play and 92nd in success rate, and 111th in EPA/rush; it has allowed 24+ in 3 of 4 games (SI, Oct 7 2026). Helps Vanderbilt.

Vanderbilt's defense ranks 72nd in adjusted EPA/play and has allowed 20+ in four straight. Its offense averages only 3.7 yards per carry (SI, Oct 7 2026), which limits how well it can attack Ole Miss's weak run defense. Helps Ole Miss.

[angle] Vanderbilt freshman QB Jared Curtis (five-star) missed the Georgia game with a knee issue and was expected to return as the starter (Saturday Down South / ClutchPoints, week of Oct 5 2026). A first game back from injury adds variance. Mixed.

[angle] Vanderbilt was putting a 10-game home winning streak on the line (La Nacion/AP preview, Oct 8 2026). Its last two games were SEC losses: by 6 to Auburn and 38-14 to Georgia (SI Oct 7; SBD Oct 10). Helps Vanderbilt at home.
[angle] Ole Miss RB Kewan Lacy was questionable but expected to play (SportsBettingDime, Oct 10 2026). His availability helps Ole Miss.

Vanderbilt has 14 sacks to Ole Miss's 6, and 4 INTs to Ole Miss's 2. Ole Miss converts 43.5% on third down, Vanderbilt 33.8% (SportsBettingDime, Oct 10). The pass rush gives Vanderbilt some turnover upside; Ole Miss's third-down edge offsets it. Mixed.
Trinidad Chambliss: 1,222 yards, 8 TD, 3 INT, 4 rushing TD; 298 yards and 2 rushing TDs at Florida (SI, Oct 7 2026). Helps Ole Miss.
Ole Miss is coming off a bye and beat LSU earlier in the season (SI, Oct 7 2026). Rest helps Ole Miss.
games.reasoning: Before contamination the evidence looked balanced: Ole Miss's better offense and the bye against its 1-3 ATS record, a bad defense and Vanderbilt's home streak, with Kalshi pricing the spread close to 50/50. I make it about Ole Miss by 9 against a 9.5 line, so I pass. The best angle was Curtis returning from a knee injury.
games.contaminationNote: Before I had decided on this game, a search for Vanderbilt QB/injury news returned an AI summary of a post-game article saying Vanderbilt trailed Ole Miss 52-10 late in the 4th quarter and Curtis threw 2 INTs. Based on the pre-game evidence above, I lock a pass (no pick), as I would have without that information.

research: [spread] Line movement: Texas opened -9.5 at some books and -8 at others, and had fallen to -7.5 by game day (Covers / SportsBettingDime summaries; TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Our 8.5 is above the closing range. Helps Oklahoma.
[spread] Splits: 72% of spread tickets on Texas while the line moved toward Oklahoma, a reverse line move that suggests sharp money on Oklahoma (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Oklahoma.

[spread] Texas is 1-3 ATS and Oklahoma 1-3 ATS. Texas's big wins have been close: 24-23 over Ohio State and 20-17 at Tennessee. It scores 33.3 ppg overall but only 24 and 20 against Power Four teams (TheSpread Oct 10; Covers Oct 10 2026). Helps Oklahoma.

[angle] The total opened around 48.5 (SportsBettingDime early-odds summary) or 40 (TheSpread) and sits at 39.5. In a game expected to land around 24-15, 8.5 points is a large share of the scoring. Helps Oklahoma.
Texas's defense ranks 3rd in net adjusted EPA/play, 5th in SP+, and allows 13.2 ppg and 271 ypg. Colin Simmons has 7.5 sacks (Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps Texas.

Oklahoma's offense is the worst in the SEC by success rate (39.2%) and scored just 12.3 ppg over its last three games (14-6 vs New Mexico, a 17-10 loss at Michigan, a 41-13 loss at Georgia) (Covers / TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Texas; this is the main case against a dog that has to score to cover.
[angle] QB John Mateer is 69th in QBR and has 4 INTs in 3 games. Venables publicly weighed other options. Mateer threw 3 INTs against Texas last year (TheSpread / Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps Texas.

[angle] Oklahoma is without WR Trell Harris and RB Xavier Robinson, and LT Michael Fasusi is doubtful; Texas is without WR Kaliq Lockett and OL Jordan Coleman (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Both offenses are short-handed, Oklahoma more so. Slightly helps Texas.

Oklahoma's defense allows 16.0 ppg and ranks 12th in havoc rate (21.6%). Arch Manning has 1 TD and 2 INTs against Power Four opponents (Covers / TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). A low-scoring game helps Oklahoma stay inside the number.

History: Texas has won 3 of 4 Red River games under Venables by an average of 32.3, with Oklahoma held under 7 in those wins (Covers, Oct 10 2026). Under the method, old head-to-head history counts less than this season's numbers. Helps Texas.
Covers projected Texas 24-13 (11 points) and played Texas -7.5. TheSpread played Oklahoma +7.5, citing the reverse line move (Oct 10 2026). Pundits split.
games.reasoning: This season Texas has played close, low-scoring games against good teams (1-3 ATS, one-score wins over Ohio State and Tennessee), the total is 39.5, and the line fell from 9.5/8 to 7.5 while 72% of tickets were on Texas. I project Texas by about 5, so Oklahoma covers +8.5. The worry is Oklahoma's offense (12.3 ppg over its last three, Mateer's turnovers), which keeps this at a lean. A Mateer benching or the line moving back up to 9+ would have changed it.

research: [spread] The spread opened at 35 on Oct 4 and fell to 32.5 while about 73% of tickets were on Ohio State, a reverse line move toward Maryland (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Maryland.

[spread] Ohio State is 4-1 ATS and has covered both times it was favored by more than 33 this season (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Ohio State is 7-3 ATS in its last 10; Maryland is 2-8 ATS in its last 10 (SI, Oct 7 2026). Helps Ohio State.

[spread] Since its one-point loss at Texas, Ohio State has outscored opponents 42.2 to 12.6 ppg, a margin near 30 (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). It won 31-14 at No. 14 Iowa. Neutral to slightly helps Ohio State at 32.5.
Maryland is 2-3 (0-2 Big Ten), with losses of 54-3 to UCLA, 48-23 at Nebraska and 35-26 to Virginia Tech. It allows 30.2 ppg (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Ohio State.
Efficiency: Maryland is 100th in adjusted EPA/play and 87th in net success rate; Ohio State is 5th and 6th (SI, Oct 7 2026). Helps Ohio State.
[angle] Maryland QB Malik Washington has thrown 5 of his 6 INTs in the last two weeks. For a 32-point dog that has to score, that's a red flag (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Ohio State.

[angle] Ohio State is thin on the offensive line and at receiver: OL Jaxon Powell and Vasean Washington are out, WR Amari Valerio-Hudson is out, and Brandon Inniss is on the availability report (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). A thinner rotation once the starters sit helps Maryland in a backdoor spot.
[angle] Ohio State plays Indiana next week, a possible look-ahead and a reason to pull starters early (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Maryland.
Maryland lost pass rusher Zahir Mathis for the season (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026), so little pressure on Julian Sayin (72.5%, 1,530 yards, 13 TD, 1 INT). Helps Ohio State.
Jeremiah Smith averages 8.8 catches, 164.6 yards and 1.8 TDs a game and is the Heisman favorite. Maryland ranks 77th in opponent EPA per pass (SI, Oct 7 2026). Helps Ohio State.
The total of 56.5 implies roughly 44-12 at -32.5. Both teams' games average about 54 combined points (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Neutral.
games.reasoning: Ohio State's form (about +30 a game since Texas, 4-1 ATS) and Maryland's collapse (lost 54-3 to UCLA, a turnover-prone QB) point one way. The sharp move from 35 to 32.5 against 73% public tickets, Ohio State's OL and WR absences, and the Indiana look-ahead point the other. I make it about 32, right on the number, so I pass. A closing number of 30 or lower or 35 or higher would have made it a play.

research: [spread] The line opened at Tennessee -13.5 and had not moved by game day despite about 69% of spread tickets on Tennessee (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). The market sat still. Neutral; slightly against Tennessee if the public money was absorbed.

[spread] Arkansas has lost every Power Four game by 27+: by 33 at Utah, 28 vs Georgia and 27 at Texas A&M. It hasn't scored more than 17 against a P4 opponent (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Tennessee.

[spread] Tennessee's SEC games have been close: a 20-17 home loss to Texas and a 24-14 win over Auburn. Its last two games totaled 37 and 38 points (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Low-scoring, tight SEC results help Arkansas against 13.5.

[angle] QB change: Faizon Brandon (shoulder) is questionable after going 0-for-3 with an INT against Auburn. George MacIntyre (8/10, 86 yards in relief) is expected to make his first career start, and Heupel hasn't confirmed it (TheSpread / Covers, Oct 10 2026). Helps Arkansas.
[angle] Tennessee hosts Alabama next week, a possible look-ahead (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Arkansas.

Matchup: Tennessee is 4th nationally in EPA per rush and runs for 240.6 ypg at 5.3 per carry (DeSean Bishop had 220 yards and 3 TDs vs Auburn). Arkansas's run defense is 128th, and it allows 59.6% on third and fourth downs (135th) (Covers / TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Tennessee.
Tennessee's passing success rate is 131st nationally (33%) (Covers, Oct 10 2026). A run-only offense with a first-time starter could struggle to pull away. Helps Arkansas.

Arkansas's offense is 131st in early-down EPA and 125th in rushing success, at 2.8 yards per carry, the worst in the Power Four. Tennessee's pass defense is 18th in EPA (Covers / TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). Helps Tennessee.

Season scoring: Tennessee 36.8 ppg, 15.2 allowed; Arkansas 19.8 ppg, 28.4 allowed (TheSpread, Oct 10 2026). The difference is about 25 a game but includes FCS-level opponents on Tennessee's side (Furman, Kennesaw State). Mixed.

[angle] Arkansas is in its first year under Ryan Silverfield. Tennessee won last year's meeting only 34-31. Weather: mostly sunny, upper 80s (TheSpread; Covers, Oct 10 2026). Heat in October slightly favors the deeper team. Slight edge to Tennessee.
Covers played Tennessee -13.5 (its AI model had 34-20); TheSpread played Arkansas +13.5 (Oct 10 2026). Pundits split.
games.reasoning: Tennessee's elite run game against Arkansas's 128th-ranked run defense, and Arkansas losing every P4 game by 27+, point to Tennessee. A first-time starting QB on a team ranked 131st in passing success, close SEC games, an unmoved line and the Alabama look-ahead point to Arkansas. I project about Tennessee by 14, right on 13.5, so I pass. Clarity on Brandon's shoulder (a healthy starter) would have pushed me to Tennessee.
